P6805.corridor_notes: Official project name: 中俄东线明哈支线天然气管道绥北支线工程 (China-Russia East Line Minghar-branch gas pipeline, Suibei branch project), built by PetroChina Kunlun Gas & Electric. Runs due west-to-east ~9 km (matches GEM LengthMergedKm=9.00) from the existing Suihua terminal station (tie-in 2m outside its perimeter wall) to a new Suibei terminal station, Beilin District, Suihua City. Pipe D219.1mm, design pressure 6.3MPa, design capacity 65 million m3/yr. Two stations built along the route: 绥北清管站 (Suibei pigging station, unmanned) and 绥北末站 (Suibei terminal station, manned). Crosses the Suibei Expressway once (bored) and 8 rural roads. A 2024 Suihua government work report confirms 'opened the China-Russia gas pipeline Suihua branch' (开通中俄天然气管道绥化支线), consistent with commissioning in 2023.
P6805.researcher_notes: GEM's existing StartLocation 'Suihua' / EndLocation 'Suibei' map exactly onto the official project's 绥化末站 (start) / 绥北末站 (end) -- strong confirmation this is the right project. The primary ref is a PDF (2022 EIA public-participation notice, PetroChina Kunlun Gas & Electric) -- resolves 200 but url_verifier's content screen doesn't reliably extract the embedded Chinese text (a known false-negative class per the verifier's own docs), so I read it directly with pdftotext -layout and confirmed the exact station names, DMS coordinates, and 9km length quoted above match GEM's row. The suihua.gov.cn government work-report source has a broken TLS cert chain (SSLError on direct fetch, matches the verifier's documented false-negative class) -- cited via a working web.archive.org snapshot instead, which the verifier passed with content match.
